# HazwoperOSHA.us - HAZWOPER Courses

> HazwoperOSHA.us provides online OSHA HAZWOPER training for employers, contractors and public agencies who train crews, with a crew training planner that turns roles and headcounts into one order, and employer resources on training by industry, OSHA state plans, public employees and volunteers (EPA 40 CFR 311), building a training program, recordkeeping, onboarding experienced hires, budgeting, multi-employer sites and Spanish-speaking crews. Contact: sales@hazwoper-osha.com, +1-866-429-6742.

## Key facts

- Provider: HAZWOPER OSHA Training LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/)
- Format: 100% online, self-paced, any device, progress saved automatically
- Certificate: certificate of completion and wallet card available immediately after passing
- Languages: English; OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER also in Spanish
- Employers: one cart and one checkout for every course and seat a team needs

## When to use HazwoperOSHA.us

- An employer, safety manager or supervisor needs to work out which HAZWOPER course each worker on a crew needs (new site workers, occasional workers, supervisors, refreshers, first responders, TSD facility staff, California crews) and order seats for everyone in one checkout.
- Someone is planning or budgeting a HAZWOPER training program: training by industry, OSHA state plans, public employees and volunteers (EPA 40 CFR 311), recordkeeping, onboarding hires with prior training, contractors on multi-employer sites, or Spanish-speaking crews.
- A company needs HAZWOPER seats for several workers at list price, Spanish and English seats in the same order, or purchase-order billing.
- A user wants a quick seat count and total: the crew training planner turns roles and headcounts into a cart.

Not a fit for: legal advice or official OSHA interpretations (use osha.gov and the regulation text); the supervised field experience and site-specific training that employers provide on site; courses outside the HAZWOPER, RCRA and hazardous waste catalog below.

## How agents can use this site

- Course facts: each course below links to a page with its length, price in US dollars, the regulation it meets and who it is for. The same catalog is JSON at https://www.hazwoperosha.us/courses.json (slug, name, price, currency, duration, citation, group, url, markdown, checkout).
- Markdown: every content page has a Markdown version at its URL plus `index.md`, for example https://www.hazwoperosha.us/index.md and https://www.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training/index.md.
- Enrollment: send the user to https://www.hazwoperosha.us/checkout.html?item=<course-slug>, for example https://www.hazwoperosha.us/checkout.html?item=osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training. The buyer enters their details and pays by card through Stripe on that page. There is no public ordering API.
- Teams and purchase orders: add several courses and seats to one cart, or call +1-866-429-6742 or email sales@hazwoper-osha.com for a quote or purchase-order billing.
- After purchase, course access, certificates and wallet cards are on the learning platform at https://hazwoper-osha.com/.

## Employer Resources

- [HAZWOPER Training by Industry: Which Courses Each Crew Needs](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-training-by-industry/): Which HAZWOPER, emergency response and RCRA courses employers in remediation, construction, oil and gas, utilities, manufacturing, waste management, healthcare and logistics typically buy for their crews.
- [OSHA State Plans and HAZWOPER: Which Rules Apply to Your Crew](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/osha-state-plans-and-hazwoper/): Which HAZWOPER rules apply in each state: federal OSHA states, state plans covering private employers, public-employee-only plans, California's 8 CCR 5192, and multi-state crews.
- [HAZWOPER for Public Employees and Volunteers (EPA 40 CFR Part 311)](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-for-public-employees-and-volunteers/): How HAZWOPER applies to state and local government employees and volunteer responders: EPA 40 CFR Part 311, public-sector state plans, fire departments, public works and training levels.
- [How to Build a HAZWOPER Training Program for Your Company](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/building-a-hazwoper-training-program/): Step-by-step guide for employers: deciding whether HAZWOPER applies, assigning training levels by role, field experience, refresher scheduling, trainers, site-specific training and budgeting.
- [HAZWOPER Training Records: What Employers Must Keep and for How Long](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-training-records-for-employers/): The records employers keep for HAZWOPER: training certificates, field experience, refreshers, medical and exposure records, respirator fit tests, RCRA training files, and an audit-ready file layout.
- [Onboarding New Hires With Prior HAZWOPER Training](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/onboarding-new-hires-with-prior-hazwoper-training/): How employers verify and accept a new hire's prior HAZWOPER training under 1910.120(e)(9), handle lapsed refreshers, and complete site-specific training, field experience, medical and fit testing.
- [Budgeting for HAZWOPER Training: A Worked Example for a 10-Person Crew](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/budgeting-for-hazwoper-training/): How to budget HAZWOPER training for a crew: first-year and ongoing costs, a worked example for a 10-person remediation crew, hidden costs like field days and wages, and ways to plan ahead.
- [Contractors, Subcontractors and Multi-Employer HAZWOPER Sites](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/contractors-and-multi-employer-hazwoper-sites/): HAZWOPER duties when several employers share a site: informing contractors under 1910.120(b), OSHA's multi-employer citation policy, verifying subcontractor training and prequalification checklists.
- [HAZWOPER Training for Spanish-Speaking and Multilingual Crews](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/guides/training-spanish-speaking-and-multilingual-crews/): OSHA expects training in a language and vocabulary workers understand. How employers train Spanish-speaking and multilingual HAZWOPER crews, check comprehension and handle site communication.

## Tools

- [HAZWOPER Crew Training Planner](https://www.hazwoperosha.us/crew-training-planner/): Free HAZWOPER crew training planner: enter how many workers you have in each role and get the courses, seats and total, then add everything to your cart in one click.

## FAQ

- **Can I buy training for my whole crew in one order?** Yes. Add every course your crew needs to the cart, set the number of seats for each course, and check out once. The crew training planner builds the cart for you from roles and headcounts.
- **Can we pay by purchase order or invoice?** Yes. Call +1-866-429-6742 or email sales@hazwoper-osha.com for purchase-order billing. Card payments are taken securely at checkout.
- **Do I need every learner's name at checkout?** No. Check out with the buyer's details and the number of seats. Learner names and emails can be sent after the order is confirmed.
- **Is there a volume discount?** Every seat is billed at the list price shown, whatever the crew size, so quotes and budgets are simple to work out.
- **Will OSHA accept online HAZWOPER training for my workers?** Online training can cover the classroom portion. You still provide supervised field experience, hands-on practice with your equipment and site-specific training.
- **Our new hires trained elsewhere. Do they have to retrain?** Not necessarily. Under 1910.120(e)(9) you can accept documented equivalent training, but new hires still need site-specific training, field experience at your site and a current annual refresher.
- **Do you have training for Spanish-speaking crews?** Yes. The OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER course is available in Spanish, and Spanish and English seats can go in the same order.
- **Which courses do California crews need?** California work falls under Cal/OSHA 8 CCR 5192. Cal/OSHA 40 hour, 24 hour and 8 hour refresher courses are available, along with TSDF versions.
